title.narrative: South Sudan Standby Partnership – Programme Costs

description.narrative: This activity South Sudan Standby Partnership – Programme Costs is a component of Humanitarian Assistance and Resilience in South Sudan (HARISS) 2015 - 2024 reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £2,664,687. It works in the following sector(s): Relief co-ordination and support services.
